course_name_original: Control Dinámico de Máquinas de Alterna
prerequisites: Dynamic analysis and modelling of electric machines
Electric machines for generation and traction

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding the principles of vector control and field orientation.
Develop control systems for dynamic models of AC machines.
To analyze the dynamics of field-oriented control and vector control.
Apply the different methods and control systems to control AC machines.

syllabus_topics: Vector Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machines
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as (0.40 × EX) + (0.40 × Assignment) + (0.10 × HW), where Assignment = (0.25 × Documentation) + (0.15 × Presentation). A minimum score of 4/10 is required for the Final Written Exam and the Final Assignment components. If any minimum requirement is not met, the final grade will be the minimum of the calculated Final Grade or 4.0. The extraordinary call follows the same structure and weighting as the ordinary call.
bibliography: Bose, B.K., 2006. Power Electronics and Motor Drives: Advances and Trends, Academic Press.
Drury, W., 2001. Control Techniques' Drives & Controls Handbook 1º ed, The Institution of Engineering and Technology.
Leonhard, W., 2001. Control of Electrical Drives 3º ed., Springer.
Novotny, D.W. & Lipo, T.A., 1996. Vector Control and Dynamics of AC Drives, Oxford University Press, USA.
institution: Universidad de Oviedo - Máster Universitario en Conversión de Energía Eléctrica y Sistemas de Potencia (EPI Gijón)
degree: Máster Universitario en Conversión de Energía Eléctrica y Sistemas de Potencia (Opción Pathway Ingenium)
